intro: Technology, manufacturing, research, software development, and government sectors have been the primary targets in a wave of remote code execution attacks between April 12 and May 18, 2026. The threat actor PhantomCore was observed exploiting critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2025-54987, CVE-2026-22679, CVE-2026-31251, CVE-2026-45033, and CVE-2026-7301, each carrying a CVSS score of 9.8. Of the 30 articles covering this tag, 18 were rated critical, 11 high, and one medium, with significant impacts reported across Asia, China, and Russia.
